3. Materials: The materials used to make an antique can also provide clues to its authenticity. A professional appraiser will look for signs of the materials used, such as the type of wood, metal, or fabric, and compare them to known examples of the item.

By examining these factors, a professional appraiser can determine the authenticity of your antiques and provide you with an accurate appraisal for insurance purposes.
